llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究LPBF不锈钢材料的SWIR成像工艺监测，未涉及生物医学植入物的任何方面。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on LPBF process monitoring for 304L stainless steel and does not address biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索SWIR成像与LPBF不锈钢零件性能的关联。
summary_zh.method: 使用SWIR相机在线监测LPBF过程，分析热信号与力学性能的关系。
summary_zh.result: SWIR信号与密度和拉伸强度相关，可用于过程监控。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和密度测量验证相关性。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the correlation between SWIR thermal imaging and mechanical properties of LPBF 304L steel.
summary_en.method: In-situ SWIR imaging during LPBF and post-build mechanical testing to establish process-property relationships.
summary_en.result: SWIR signals correlate with density and tensile strength, enabling process monitoring.
summary_en.validation: Validated via tensile testing and density measurements.

papers.title: Quantifying Oxygen Levels in 3D Bioprinted Cell-Laden Thick Constructs with Perfusable Microchannel Networks.
papers.abstract: The survival and function of thick tissue engineered implanted constructs depends on pre-existing, embedded, functional, vascular-like structures that are able to integrate with the host vasculature. Bioprinting was employed to build perfusable vascular-like networks within thick constructs. However, the improvement of oxygen transportation facilitated by these vascular-like networks was directly quantified. Using an optical fiber oxygen sensor, we measured the oxygen content at different positions within 3D bioprinted constructs with and without perfusable microchannel networks. Perfusion was found to play an essential role in maintaining relatively high oxygen content in cell-laden constructs and, consequently, high cell viability. The concentration of oxygen changes following switching on and off the perfusion. Oxygen concentration depletes quickly after pausing perfusion but recovers rapidly after resuming the perfusion. The quantification of oxygen levels within cell-laden hydrogel constructs could provide insight into channel network design and cellular responses.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化3D生物打印厚组织构建中灌注微通道对氧气传输的改善。
summary_zh.method: 使用光纤氧传感器测量含/不含微通道生物打印构建物不同位置的氧含量。
summary_zh.result: 灌注维持高氧含量和高细胞活力，停止灌注后氧浓度迅速下降，恢复灌注后迅速回升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过光纤氧传感器直接测量氧含量进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the improvement in oxygen transport facilitated by perfusable vascular-like networks within thick bioprinted tissue constructs.
summary_en.method: An optical fiber oxygen sensor was used to measure oxygen content at various positions in 3D bioprinted constructs with and without perfusable microchannel networks.
summary_en.result: Perfusion maintained relatively high oxygen content and cell viability; oxygen concentration depleted quickly upon stopping perfusion and recovered rapidly upon resumption.
summary_en.validation: Direct measurement of oxygen levels using an optical fiber oxygen sensor provided experimental validation.
